newsitem.title: USA: N.J. seeks to dismiss Trump tunnel lawsuit - paper.
newsitem.headline: N.J. seeks to dismiss Trump tunnel lawsuit - paper.

text.p: New Jersey and the state's Casino Reinvestment Development Authority asked a federal court to dismiss a lawsuit filed by Trump Hotels & Casino Resorts Inc, the Philadelphia Inquirer reported Friday.

The Trump suit attempts to derail a $330 million tunnel project in Atlantic City that Trump contends gives his casino rivals an unfair advantage. The state's motion says the federal court has no jurisdiction in the matter.

The state's response also asks the court to determine that various uses of casino and sales tax revenues to support projects like the tunnel do not violate the state constitution, as Trump contends, the newspaper said.
